description: This file contains template implementations for various random distribution functions (e.g., uniform, normal, log-normal, geometric, exponential, Cauchy, Bernoulli) in the ATen native distribution namespace of PyTorch. It includes utility functions for updating range bounds, macros for checks, and detailed template functions for generating random tensors with specified distributions.
